evidence: state.EditorState.selection.B1: cm6 returns the start selection object for empty changes (mirrors/cm6/state/src/selection.ts:127-130, transaction.ts:211-213); EditorSelection has no identity in Ferrum (docs/parity/ferrum-state/design.md:180), so the counterpart is a value equal in every observable field. crates/ferrum-state/tests/written_state.rs:373-387 asserts same.selection() == st.selection() through PartialEq, which per N5 compares only from/to of each range and the main index, ignoring assoc, goal_column and bidi_level; and the start selection (anchor 1, head 3, :376) sets none of them. A rebuild that dropped a range's goal column, bidi level or assoc would pass. Low: the code returns self.clone() for empty changes (crates/ferrum-state/src/selection.rs:221-222), which keeps every field; the second case (:381-386, an insertion after the selection) is outside B1's input class. This is the pattern U4a found: cm6's === asserted through a Rust PartialEq. Passes (cargo test -p ferrum-state --features __test --test written_state, the 11 tests of U4b: 11 passed).
